why: the pure globals, each a function of its arguments: widest and lowest nest Math.max and Math.min (proved: both are exact, associative and commutative on binary64); gap takes the absolute value of the negated difference (proved: |-x| is |x| on every double; the swapped operands |l - h| are also equal, but the solver answers unknown within 60 s on that query); trend writes -sign(-x) (proved); ceiling writes -floor(-x) of a scaled ratio (proved; the fraction makes both files real); nearest floors x + 0.5 for Math.round (WITNESS at 0.49999999999999994, where the sum rounds up to 1); chopped is the truncation by sign (proved); halves multiplies by 0.5 for the division by 2 (proved); caption is a template for String and a concatenation (proved); root names Math.sqrt before returning it (proved); asCount drops Number of a number (proved: ToNumber of a number is itself); isWhole names Number.isInteger before the field write (proved: one bodiless function of the number); finite tests another field (unproved, WITNESS); quote names JSON.stringify of a string before the write (proved: a primitive has no toJSON, so it is a function of the string); encodeCount appends an empty string (proved); stamp writes two fields of one record from another record that may be the same one, in the other order (proved: the reads and the writes touch different fields); parsed is +s for Number(s) of a string: equal in JavaScript, and unproved, since a conversion of a string may be NaN and stays out.
